newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gehe says plans key announcement today.
newsitem.headline: Gehe says plans key announcement today.

text.p: German pharmaceuticals wholesaler Gehe AG, locked in a bitter takeover battle for U.K. group Lloyds Chemists, on Friday said it planned to make a key announcement this afternoon.
Gehe refused to comment on news that U.K. Unichem, its rival in the bid for Lloyds Chemists, had renewed its bid for the drug wholesaler saying only it planned to make a statement later.
"We will make an announcement between 2 p.m. and 3 p.m. (1200 and 1300 GMT)," a Gehe official said, declining to be drawn out what the statement may be about.
Analysts have speculated that Gehe will also present a new bid but said the bid may now well be lower as Lloyds Chemists results have suffered over the protracted 10-month takeover struggle.
Additionally Gehe officials have said Lloyds Chemist's worth was now less after the U.K. monopolies commission had demanded that each potential buyer sell off some of Lloyds Chemists units.
Gehe earlier this year made an all-cash offer amounting to around 500 pence per share.
Earlier this morning Unichem renewed its offer valued at 657.6 million sterling.
